Install wordcraft on Omarchy

Clean-room word processor in pure Rust that opens and saves Word documents

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add wordcraft-bin
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.12.0-1:
    pacman -Qi wordcraft-bin

Open and use wordcraft

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql wordcraft-bin

Frequently asked questions

How do I install wordcraft on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add wordcraft-bin. The download is 104.2 MB and it takes 210.1 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is wordcraft free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed Apache-2.0 OR MIT, OFL-1.1.

How do I uninstall wordcraft?

Run omarchy pkg drop wordcraft-bin. It removes the package from your system.

What does wordcraft depend on?

The package declares 9 dependencies: glibc, libgcc, dbus, libxcb, libxkbcommon, libxkbcommon-x11, wayland, vulkan-icd-loader, hicolor-icon-theme. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is wordcraft in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as wordcraft-bin (version 0.12.0-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. storytold makes it. Project site: https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft.
